item.name: Shield Breaker
item.activation: Use before the spike you want to drive through a block.
item.chargeBehavior: Builds through ball touches and scoring when you had the last touch.
item.effect: Makes the next spike much harder for a block to stop.
item.cardSummary: A Secret offense ability for putting extra pressure on blockers.

item.name: Curve Spike
item.activation: Use on the attack or serve where an angled line is useful.
item.chargeBehavior: Builds through ball touches and scoring when you had the last touch.
item.effect: Adds curve control to a spike or serve, changing the line defenders need to read.
item.cardSummary: A Godly offense ability for attacks that rely on changing the ball's line.

item.name: Divine Strength
item.activation: Use before an attack when extra spike pressure matters.
item.chargeBehavior: Builds through ball touches and scoring when you had the last touch.
item.effect: Raises the pressure of a spike.
item.cardSummary: A Godly offense ability for adding pressure to a spike.

item.name: Extra Touch
item.activation: Use when the rally needs one more possession.
item.chargeBehavior: Builds through ball touches and scoring when you had the last touch.
item.effect: Creates one more touch opportunity during a rally.
item.cardSummary: A Secret utility ability for keeping a rally alive when one touch is not enough.

item.name: Magnetic Pull
item.activation: Use when a nearby ball needs to be pulled into your hitting zone.
item.chargeBehavior: Builds through ball touches and scoring when you had the last touch.
item.effect: Pulls a nearby ball toward the player before the next contact.
item.cardSummary: A Secret utility ability that helps pull a nearby ball into reach.

item.name: Zero Gravity Set
item.activation: Use before the set you want to shape for a different attack approach.
item.chargeBehavior: Builds through ball touches and scoring when you had the last touch.
item.effect: Gives the next set a more controlled, floaty setup for an attack.
item.cardSummary: A Legendary utility ability for setting up a different attack rhythm.

item.name: Moonball
item.bestFor: Receiver who needs a high reset
item.activation: Use on a bump when a high, deep return is safer or more useful.
item.chargeBehavior: Builds through ball touches and scoring when you had the last touch.
item.effect: Sends a bump high and deep with a different return arc.
item.cardSummary: A Rare utility ability for changing a bump into a high, deep return.

item.name: Team Spirit
item.activation: Use when the team needs coordinated movement during the rally.
item.chargeBehavior: Builds through ball touches and scoring when you had the last touch.
item.effect: Gives the team a coordinated movement boost when the ability is used.
item.cardSummary: A Common utility ability for helping a team move together.

item.name: Steel Block
item.activation: Use before the block you want to strengthen.
item.chargeBehavior: Builds through ball touches and scoring when you had the last touch.
item.effect: Strengthens the next block and sends a successful block down with more force.
item.cardSummary: A Legendary defense ability for making a planned block count.

item.name: Rolling Thunder
item.activation: Use before a defensive dive when the ball is out in front.
item.chargeBehavior: Builds through ball touches and scoring when you had the last touch.
item.effect: Turns a defensive dive into a long-distance court-coverage option.
item.cardSummary: A Common defense ability for reaching balls that are far out in front.

item.name: Lead Feet
item.availability: Limited / historical; last recorded return ended May 23, 2026
item.activation: Use while airborne to return to the ground; a full charge supports up to three uses.
item.chargeBehavior: Builds through ball touches and scoring when you had the last touch.
item.effect: Lets the player return to the ground from mid-air and supports up to three uses from a full charge.
item.cardSummary: A limited Secret movement ability for controlling an airborne recovery.

item.name: Redirection Jump
item.activation: Use in the air when you need to change your attack or recovery direction.
item.chargeBehavior: Builds through ball touches and scoring when you had the last touch.
item.effect: Lets the player change direction in mid-air for a different attack or recovery line.
item.cardSummary: A Godly movement ability for changing direction after leaving the ground.

item.name: Boom Jump
item.activation: Use before a high contact, block, or attack.
item.chargeBehavior: Builds through ball touches and scoring when you had the last touch.
item.effect: Boosts a jump so the player can reach higher contacts, blocks, and attacks.
item.cardSummary: A Rare movement ability for reaching higher points on the court.

item.name: Super Sprint
item.activation: Use when a quick reposition can save the next play.
item.chargeBehavior: Builds through ball touches and scoring when you had the last touch.
item.effect: Adds a short speed burst for quick repositioning and saves.
item.cardSummary: A Common movement ability for getting into position faster.
